verdict.rationale: Customer.io ships its own runnable API artifacts: a first-party Postman collection for getting started with its APIs, a published OpenAPI spec (confirmed by an HTTP 200 probe), and a CLI where every endpoint is self-describing via `cio schema`. However, nothing shows an interactive, in-browser API reference with try-it or runnable examples on the docs site itself. missing for 10: documented interactive API reference UI with in-page runnable requests, runnable code examples per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of the explorer experience.
